module: Small compatibility layer for lua-websockets bit operations. If the 'bit32' library (Lua 5.2) exists, it is returned with rol/ror added as aliases of lrotate/rrotate; otherwise the module returns LuaJIT's 'bit' library (BitOp). No functions of its own: the module directly returns the table of operations (band, bor, bxor, lshift, rshift...).
notes: In BeamNG (LuaJIT), the 'bit' branch is used, unless a 'bit32' module is available.
